limitations: Same-author probes written after the implementation. Score source admission without packing.

documents.name: shims.md
documents.text: Metal shims must be deburred, rinsed, and dried after cutting.

documents.name: air-filters.md
documents.text: Air filters must be inspected and hung after drying.

documents.name: wheel-guards.md
documents.text: Operators must brush the mold and buff wheel guards before storage.

documents.name: panel-seals.md
documents.text: Inspectors must check panel seals during the final check.

documents.name: meter-sheet.md
documents.text: Technicians must document meter readings after calibration.

documents.name: meter-log.md
documents.text: Technicians must record meter readings after calibration and before leaving.

documents.name: archive-crates.md
documents.text: Staff must seal archive crates before transit.

documents.name: cargo-labels.md
documents.text: Staff must stamp cargo labels after transit.

Explain the requirement to document meter readings before leaving.
